FN-7BGUL22-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 157
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/18/2025
Senate Bill 157 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Board of Pardons and
Paroles by a board estimated $48,000 for initial set-up and an estimated $34,000 annually for
recurring costs, to provide the necessary equipment and support for inmates to attend parole
hearings virtually.
In addition this bill could increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections by an
undetermined amount to allow inmates to attend parole hearings virtually.
